The '''2017–18 [[Cypriot First Division]]''' was the 79th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league. The season began on 19 August 2017 and is ended on 13 May 2018.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/30940/3228359/254|script-title=el:Αναλυτικό Πρόγραμμα|language=el|publisher=CFA|date=7 July 2017|access-date=26 February 2018|archive-date=4 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200404215810/http://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/30940/3228359/254|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Teams==

===Promotion and relegation (pre-season)===
[[Anagennisi Deryneia FC|Anagennisi Deryneia]] and [[AEZ Zakakiou]] were relegated at the end of the first-phase of the [[2016–17 Cypriot First Division|2016–17 season]] after finishing in the bottom two places of the table. They were joined by [[Karmiotissa FC|Karmiotissa]], who finished at the bottom of the second-phase relegation group.

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2016–17 Cypriot Second Division|2016–17 Second Division]] champions [[Alki Oroklini]], runners-up [[Pafos FC]] and third-placed team [[Olympiakos Nicosia]].

===Scoring===
*First goal of the season: '''73 minutes and 36 seconds''' – {{flagicon|FRA}} [[Chafik Tigroudja]] ([[Alki Oroklini|Alki]]) against [[Ethnikos Achna FC|Ethnikos]] (''19 August 2017'')
*Fastest goal of the season: '''0 minutes and 13 seconds''' – {{flagicon|BEN}} [[Mickaël Poté]] ([[APOEL FC|APOEL]]) against [[Anorthosis Famagusta FC|Anorthosis]] (''20 December 2017'')
*Latest goal of the season: '''97 minutes and 20 seconds''' – {{flagicon|ARG}} [[Emilio Zelaya]] ([[Apollon Limassol|Apollon]]) against [[Ermis Aradippou FC|Ermis]] (''18 September 2017'')
*First scored penalty kick of the season: '''81 minutes and 27 seconds''' – {{flagicon|POR}} [[Tiago Gomes (footballer, born 1985)|Tiago Gomes]] ([[Doxa Katokopias FC|Doxa]]) against [[Ermis Aradippou FC|Ermis]] (''27 August 2017'')
*First own goal of the season: '''86 minutes and 25 seconds''' – {{flagicon|GRE}} [[Kiriakos Stratilatis]] ([[Alki Oroklini|Alki]]) for [[Anorthosis Famagusta FC|Anorthosis]] (''27 August 2017'')
*Most goals scored in a match by one player: '''3 goals'''
**9 players
*Most scored goals in a single fixture – '''28 goals''' (Fixture 22)
**Fixture 22 results: [[Olympiakos Nicosia|Olympiakos]] 1–2 [[AEL Limassol|AEL]], [[Alki Oroklini|Alki]] 3–4 [[Ermis Aradippou FC|Ermis]], [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] 5–1 [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]], [[Apollon Limassol|Apollon]] 1–2 [[APOEL FC|APOEL]], [[Ethnikos Achna FC|Ethnikos]] 0–4 [[Aris Limassol FC|Aris]], [[Pafos FC|Pafos]] 0–1 [[Anorthosis Famagusta FC|Anorthosis]], [[AEK Larnaca FC|AEK]] 4–0 [[Doxa Katokopias FC|Doxa]].

===Discipline===
* First yellow card of the season: '''26 minutes''' – {{flagicon|FRA}} [[Jean-Baptiste Pierazzi]] for [[Alki Oroklini|Alki]] against [[Ethnikos Achna FC|Ethnikos]] (''19 August 2017'')
* First red card of the season: '''81 minutes''' – {{flagicon|CMR}} [[Evariste Ngolok]] for [[Aris Limassol FC|Aris]] against [[Anorthosis Famagusta FC|Anorthosis]] (''10 September 2017'')
* Most yellow cards in a single match: '''10'''
** [[APOEL FC|APOEL]] 2–1 [[AEL Limassol|AEL]] – 3 for APOEL ([[Lorenzo Ebecilio]], [[Agustín Farías]], [[Mickaël Poté]]) and 7 for AEL ([[Fidelis Irhene]], [[Vozinha]], [[Marco Soares (footballer)|Marco Soares]], [[Dani Benítez]], [[Andreas Avraam]], [[Marco Airosa]], [[Mesca]]) (''17 January 2018'')
** [[Alki Oroklini|Alki]] 3–3 [[Aris Limassol FC|Aris]] – 6 for Alki ([[Abdelaye Diakité]], [[Yoann Tribeau]], [[Willy Semedo]], [[Jean-Baptiste Pierazzi]], [[Fabrício Simões]], [[Panagiotis Frageskou]]) and 4 for Aris ([[Edin Nuredinoski]], [[Markos Maragoudakis]], [[Vlatko Drobarov]], [[Kyriakos Panagi]]) (''17 September 2017'')
** [[AEK Larnaca FC|AEK]] 1–1 [[Apollon Limassol|Apollon]] – 5 for AEK ([[Alberto Sansimena Chamorro|Tete]], [[Florian Taulemesse]], [[Marios Antoniades]], [[David Català]], [[Daniel Mojsov]]) and 5 for Apollon ([[Héctor Yuste]], [[Valentin Roberge]], [[Esteban Sachetti]], [[Allan (footballer, born 1997)|Allan]], [[Emilio Zelaya]]) (''5 November 2017'')
** [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] 5–1 [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] – 3 for Omonia ([[Hedwiges Maduro]], [[Nicandro Breeveld]], [[Demetris Christofi]]) and 7 for Nea Salamina ([[Andreas Karo]], [[Anderson Correia (footballer)|Anderson Correia]], [[Carlão (footballer, born August 1986)|Carlão]], [[Robert Veselovsky]] (2), [[David Poljanec]], [[Taron Voskanyan]]) (''30 January 2018'')
** [[APOEL FC]] 2–1 [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] – 3 for APOEL ([[Roland Sallai]], [[Emilio Nsue]], [[Lorenzo Ebecilio]]) and 7 for Omonia ([[Jaílson Araújo|Jaílson]], [[Matt Derbyshire]], [[Mamadu Candé]], [[William Ribeiro Soares|William Soares]], [[Loukas Vyntra]], [[Rubenilson dos Santos da Rocha|Kanu]], [[Theophilus Solomon]]) (''17 February 2018'')
** [[Apollon Limassol|Apollon]] 5–1 [[AEL Limassol|AEL]] – 4 for Apollon ([[Alef (footballer, born 1995)|Alef]], [[Esteban Sachetti]], [[Fotios Papoulis]], [[Anton Maglica]]) and 6 for AEL ([[Leandro Miguel Pereira Silva|Leandro Silva]], [[David Texeira]], [[Bogdan Mitrea]], [[Dani Benítez]], [[Marco Airosa]], [[Kevin Lafrance]]) (''3 March 2018'')
* Most red cards in a single match: '''2'''
** [[Pafos FC|Pafos]] 0–1 [[AEL Limassol|AEL]] – 1 for Pafos ([[Dmitri Torbinski]]) and 1 for AEL ([[Kevin Lafrance]]) (''14 January 2018'')
